R script for generating Figure 4g

This script visualizes NES distributions with violin plots for common cancer types in HCMI and CCLE.

Note: OncoMatch results (HCMI/CCLE models vs. TCGA tumors) are required to run this code.

Please (1) download supplementary_data_OncoMatchAnalysis_HCMI-vs-CCLE_bestModel-vs-TCGA.tar.gz from Files/Data/Transcriptional Data Analysis Subgroup Files/supplementary_data_oncomatch on the HCMI synapse page, and(2) unzip it in the same directory as this script.

Load input data (e.g. OncoMatch results) for violin plots:

load(file="./supplementary_data_OncoMatchAnalysis_HCMI-vs-CCLE_bestModel-vs-TCGA/OncoMatch_output/nesTable-cohortSizeTable_modelHCMI-modelCCLE-vs-TCGA.rda")

This file contains two objects:

  1. gdat: A table showing NES values for each model sample and its corresponding TCGA signature.

  2. gdat_n: A table detailing the cohort sizes (number of models in HCMI/CCLE or number of tumors in TCGA) for cancer types.

Group label refining

Update group labels to include the size of each cohort using the gdat_n data:

gdat$group = factor(gdat$group, levels=gdat_n$group)
levels(gdat$group) = paste(gdat_n$group, "\n(CCLE=", gdat_n$ccle, ";\nHCMI=",gdat_n$hcmi,";\nTCGA=",gdat_n$tcga,")", sep="")

gdat$set = factor(gdat$set, levels=c("hcmi","ccle","model"))

The dataset annotations are as follows: “hcmi” for HCMI models, “ccle” for CCLE models, and “model” for both HCMI and CCLE models.

Sorting group labes based on significance levels

Cancer types are sorted in decreasing order of statistical significance based on the Mann-Whitney U-test (one-tailed) to compare the median NES of HCMI models to CCLE models. A smaller p-value indicates greater significance for HCMI models having a higher median NES. This one-tailed U-test is used to arrange the cancer types in the Violin plot. Note that p-values from the two-tailed U-test are annotated with asterisks in the final plot.

comp.pval = ddply(gdat,.(group), function(x) wilcox.test(x$nes[x$set=="hcmi"], x$nes[x$set=="ccle"], alternative="greater")$p.value)
comp.pval = comp.pval[order(comp.pval$V1),]
gdat$group = factor(gdat$group, levels=comp.pval$group)

head(comp.pval)

Violin plots for NES distributions:

gbox = ggplot(gdat) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=group, y=nes, fill=set), scale='width', alpha=0.25, 
              width=0.7, lwd=0.25) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x=group, y=nes, fill=set), width=0.25, 
               outliers = FALSE,
               position=position_dodge(0.7), lwd=0.25, alpha=0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, col="grey30")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("orangered","dodgerblue","green3"), 
                    breaks=c("hcmi","ccle","model"), 
                    labels=c("HCMI","CCLE","all models"),
                    name=NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-20,20,by=5)) +
  theme_bw()+ 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5),
        legend.position = c(0.5, 0.07),legend.direction="horizontal") +
  xlab(NULL) + ylab("OncoMatch [NES]")

Add p-values (two-tailed U-test; BH-adjusted) onto the box plots

Ralculate p-values for all pairs (i.e. hcmi-vs-ccle, hcmi-vs-model(hcmi+ccle), ccle-vs-model(hcmi+ccle)) in each cancer type:

stat.test <- gdat %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  wilcox_test(nes ~ set) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")
## Remove instances that were not significant (adjust p>0.05):
stat.test = stat.test[stat.test$p.adj.signif!="ns",]
## Add xy positions
stat.test <- stat.test %>% add_xy_position(x = "group", dodge = 0.8)

stat.df = as.data.frame(stat.test)
## statistical significance between the best set and the combined models (HCMI+CCLE)
stat.df.model= ddply(stat.df,.(group), function(x){
  x$y.position = min(x$y.position)
  x=x[x$group2=="model",]  # The smaller p-value in the set (HCMI or CCLE) vs. combined model (HCMI+CCLE) comparisons implies a significant improvement in the median NES of the combined models (HCMI+CCLE).
  return(x) 
})
## statistical significance between HCMI and CCLE models
stat.df.best= ddply(stat.df,.(group), function(x){
  x=x[x$group2!="model",] ## this only considers HCMI vs CCLE
  return(x)
})
## Identify a significant trend: (+) indicates the median NES of HCMI is greater than that of CCLE, while (-) indicates the opposite:
stat.df.best$sign =sapply(stat.df.best$group, function(k){
  r = sign(median(gdat$nes[gdat$group==k & gdat$set=="hcmi"])-
             median(gdat$nes[gdat$group==k & gdat$set=="ccle"]))
})
## For simplicity in visualization, statistical significance (asterisk) was annotated for the best set between HCMI and CCLE for each cancer type. The following details outline the x coordinates for the corresponding best sets across cancer types.
stat.df.best$xf = stat.df.best$xmin
stat.df.best$xf[stat.df.best$sign==-1] = stat.df.best$xmax[stat.df.best$sign==-1]
stat.df.best$y.position = stat.df.best$y.position-0.3
## Adjust y coordinates for significance annotations (asterisk symbols)
stat.df.model$y.position[stat.df.model$group1=="ccle"]=stat.df.model$y.position[stat.df.model$group1=="ccle"] + 0.3
## Add the significance annotation to the violin plot:
gbox_sig = gbox + 
  geom_text(data=stat.df.best, aes(x=xf, y=y.position, label=p.adj.signif)) +
  geom_text(data=stat.df.model, aes(x=xmax, y=y.position, label=p.adj.signif))
gbox_sig

Violin plots for the top 11 significant cancer types, where the median NES of HCMI significantly exceeds that of CCLE.

gsub= gdat[is.element(gdat$group, levels(gdat$group)[1:11]),]
gsub$group= factor(gsub$group, levels= levels(gdat$group)[1:11])

# Formatting x-labels:
gdat_n2 = gdat_n[sapply(levels(gdat$group)[1:11],function(x) match(strsplit(x,split="\n")[[1]][1], gdat_n$group)),]
gdat_n2$label= gsub(" Cancer","", gdat_n2$group)
gdat_n2$label[grep("Esophageal", gdat_n2$label)]="Esophagus"
gdat_n2$label[grep("Ovarian", gdat_n2$label)]="Ovary"
gdat_n2$label[grep("Endometrial", gdat_n2$label)]="Endometrium/Uterus"
gdat_n2$label[grep("Colon", gdat_n2$label)]="Colon/Rectum"

gdat_n2$label2 = paste(gdat_n2$label, "\n(H:",gdat_n2$hcmi,", C:",gdat_n2$ccle,")",sep="")


# The NES Violin plots for the 11 cancer types:
gbox.topSig = ggplot(gsub) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=group, y=nes, fill=set), scale='width', alpha=0.25, 
              width=0.7, lwd=0.25) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x=group, y=nes, fill=set), width=0.25, 
               outliers = FALSE,
               position=position_dodge(0.7), lwd=0.25, alpha=0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, col="grey30", linetype="dashed")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("orangered","dodgerblue","green3"), 
                    breaks=c("hcmi","ccle","model"), 
                    labels=c("HCMI","CCLE","all models"), name=NULL) +
  theme_bw()+ 
  scale_x_discrete(breaks=levels(gdat$group)[1:11], label=gdat_n2$label2) +
  # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5)) +
  xlab(NULL) + ylab("OncoMatch [NES]") 


# statistical significance for the 11 cancer types
stat.df.model.sub= stat.df.model[is.element(stat.df.model$group, gsub$group),]
stat.df.best.sub= stat.df.best[is.element(stat.df.best$group, gsub$group),]

# The final NES violin plots with significance annotation for the 11 cancer types:
gbox_sig2 = gbox.topSig + 
  geom_text(data=stat.df.best.sub, aes(x=xf, y=y.position, label=p.adj.signif)) +
  geom_text(data=stat.df.model.sub, aes(x=xmax, y=y.position, label=p.adj.signif))
gbox_sig2

Violin plots for the remaining cancer types (n=8) which showed no significant difference in the median NES of HCMI compared to CCLE.

gsub= gdat[is.element(gdat$group, levels(gdat$group)[12:19]),]
gsub$group= factor(gsub$group, levels= rev(levels(gdat$group)[12:19])) #The eight cancer types were re-sorted by the decreasing statistical significance of their greater NES median for CCLE compared to HCMI

gdat_n2 = gdat_n[sapply(levels(gsub$group),function(x) match(strsplit(x,split="\n")[[1]][1], gdat_n$group)),]
gdat_n2$label= gsub(" Cancer","", gdat_n2$group)
gdat_n2$label[grep("Esophageal", gdat_n2$label)]="Esophagus"
gdat_n2$label[grep("Ovarian", gdat_n2$label)]="Ovary"
gdat_n2$label[grep("Endometrial", gdat_n2$label)]="Endometrium/Uterus"
gdat_n2$label[grep("Colon", gdat_n2$label)]="Colon/Rectum"

gdat_n2$label2 = paste(gdat_n2$label, "\n(HCMI:",gdat_n2$hcmi,", CCLE:",gdat_n2$ccle,")",sep="")


# The NES Violin plots for the 8 cancer types:
gbox.topSig = ggplot(gsub) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=group, y=nes, fill=set), scale='width', alpha=0.25, 
              width=0.7, lwd=0.25) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x=group, y=nes, fill=set), width=0.25, 
               outliers = FALSE,
               position=position_dodge(0.7), lwd=0.25, alpha=0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, col="grey30", linetype="dashed")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("orangered","dodgerblue","green3"), 
                    breaks=c("hcmi","ccle","model"), 
                    labels=c("HCMI","CCLE","all models"), name=NULL) +
  theme_bw()+ 
  scale_x_discrete(breaks=levels(gsub$group), label=gdat_n2$label2) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-10,20, by=5)) + 
  # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5)) +
  xlab(NULL) + ylab("OncoMatch [NES]") 


# statistical significance for the 8 cancer types
stat.df.model.sub= stat.df.model[match(levels(gsub$group), stat.df.model$group),]
stat.df.model.sub$xmax = rev(stat.df.model.sub$xmax) - 11

stat.df.best.sub= stat.df.best[match(levels(gsub$group), stat.df.best$group, nomatch=0),]
stat.df.best.sub$xf = 1:nrow(stat.df.best.sub)

# The final NES violin plots with significance annotation for the 8 cancer types:
gbox_sig2 = gbox.topSig + 
  geom_text(data=stat.df.best.sub, aes(x=xf, y=y.position, label=p.adj.signif)) +
  geom_text(data=stat.df.model.sub, aes(x=xmax, y=y.position, label=p.adj.signif))
gbox_sig2
